results.sql:
SELECT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12'
   OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Ni'
  AND m.number_of_elements > 1
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE m.number_of_elements = 2
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.atomic_fraction = 0.75
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.atomic_fraction = 0.25
  )
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    c.element = 'Co'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.crystal_system
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.crystal_system = 'cubic'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY m.formula ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    c.element = 'Al'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.space_group_number
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.space_group_number = 221
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Ti'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS l12_compound_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    c.element = 'Pt'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c_ni
    WHERE c_ni.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c_ni.element = 'Ni'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c_al
    WHERE c_al.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c_al.element = 'Al'
)
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Ga'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    c.element = 'Fe'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT c.element, c.site_label
FROM composition c
WHERE c.site_label = 'A-site'
ORDER BY c.element
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system
FROM material_entry m
ORDER BY m.chemical_system, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht, s.crystal_system
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.crystal_system = 'cubic'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND c.element = 'W'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ni'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.chemical_system, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0
ORDER BY m.chemical_system ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Al'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND m.number_of_elements >= 2
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.prototype, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull > 0.001
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Co'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.lattice_a >= 3.5
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  )
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.4
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.01
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ti'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE m.chemical_system = 'Al-Ni'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND s.lattice_a < 3.6
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, c.atomic_fraction, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Nb'
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Sc'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.chemical_system != 'Al-Ni'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site, COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS l12_compound_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY l12_compound_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.lattice_a >= 4.0
ORDER BY s.lattice_a DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  c.element,
  c.atomic_fraction,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Pd'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  CASE
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 'stable'
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 'metastable'
    ELSE 'unstable'
  END AS stability,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Cu'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 1
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 2
    ELSE 3
  END,
  ps.energy_above_hull ASC,
  m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    c.site_label = 'B-site'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.volume_per_atom <= 12
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ir'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.chemical_system, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.number_of_elements = 2
ORDER BY m.chemical_system, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY s.lattice_a DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Ni'
  )
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ca.element AS a_site,
       ca.atomic_fraction AS a_site_atomic_fraction,
       cb.element AS b_site,
       cb.atomic_fraction AS b_site_atomic_fraction,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition ca ON ca.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition cb ON cb.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ca.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND cb.site_label = 'B-site'
ORDER BY ca.element, cb.element, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) <= 0.1
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM composition c
      WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
        AND c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site,
       AVG(s.lattice_a) AS avg_lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY c.element
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.3
  AND s.lattice_a BETWEEN 3.5 AND 3.7
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.unit = 'GPa'
  AND cp.value >= 180
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Co'
  AND c.atomic_fraction >= 0.5
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       c.element AS b_site,
       c.site_label,
       c.atomic_fraction,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND c.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       cp.value AS shear_modulus,
       cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'shear_modulus'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ni'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
    AND c.site_label = 'A-site'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.55) <= 0.1
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY cp.value DESC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.55) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.formula IN ('Co3Ti', 'Ni3Al')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) AS stable_l12_al_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = FALSE) AS not_stable_l12_al_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Al'
  )
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull > 0.001
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS b_site,
       COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS stable_l12_compound_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY stable_l12_compound_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  m.source_db,
  s.prototype,
  s.strukturbericht,
  s.crystal_system,
  s.space_group_number,
  s.lattice_a,
  s.lattice_b,
  s.lattice_c,
  s.volume_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND calc.functional = 'GGA-PBE'
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable,
       cp.property_name,
       cp.tensor_component,
       cp.value,
       cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE c.element = 'Fe'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND (
      cp.property_name IN ('C11', 'C12', 'C44')
      OR cp.tensor_component IN ('C11', 'C12', 'C44')
  )
ORDER BY m.formula, cp.property_name, cp.tensor_component
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.value >= 160
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable,
       s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC,
         ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c_a.element AS a_site, c_b.element AS b_site
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c_a.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND c_b.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
ORDER BY m.formula, c_a.element, c_b.element
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
  (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull = 0
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.4
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)(Sc|Ti|V|Cr|Mn|Fe|Co|Ni|Cu|Zn|Y|Zr|Nb|Mo|Tc|Ru|Rh|Pd|Ag|Cd|Hf|Ta|W|Re|Os|Ir|Pt|Au|Hg|Rf|Db|Sg|Bh|Hs|Mt|Ds|Rg|Cn)(-|$)'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.number_of_elements > 1
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
  AND m.number_of_elements >= 2
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC,
         ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  phase_diagram_entry.hull_distance AS energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  (
    (1 - phase_diagram_entry.hull_distance / 0.05) * 0.4
    + (1 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 0.3) * 0.3
    + (cp.value / 300) * 0.3
  ) AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_diagram_entry ON phase_diagram_entry.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND phase_diagram_entry.hull_distance <= 0.05
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.unit = 'GPa'
ORDER BY weighted_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (
      EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM composition c
          WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
            AND c.element = 'Ni'
      )
      OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM composition c
          WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
            AND c.element = 'Co'
      )
  )
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT c_a.element AS a_site,
       c_b.element AS b_site,
       COUNT(*) AS combination_count,
       AVG(c_a.atomic_fraction) AS avg_a_site_atomic_fraction,
       AVG(c_b.atomic_fraction) AS avg_b_site_atomic_fraction,
       AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) AS count,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS stable_percentage
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
GROUP BY c_a.element, c_b.element
ORDER BY stable_percentage DESC, avg_energy_above_hull ASC, combination_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  ((1 - ps.energy_above_hull / 0.05) * 0.35
   + (1 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 0.3) * 0.35
   + (cp.value / 300) * 0.30) AS total_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY total_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  pde.hull_distance AS e_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  ((1 - pde.hull_distance / 0.05) * 0.35
   + (1 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.35
   + (LEAST(cp.value, 300) / 300) * 0.30) AS score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_diagram_entry pde ON pde.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND pde.hull_distance <= 0.05
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Co'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE
    (m.formula = 'Co3Ti' OR m.reduced_formula = 'Co3Ti')

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    CASE
        WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 'stable'
        WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 'metastable'
        ELSE 'unstable'
    END AS stability
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  (
    (1 - LEAST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.05) / 0.05) * 0.30
    + (1 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.25
    + CASE
        WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3 THEN 0.20
        ELSE 0.10
      END
  ) AS design_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.chemical_system != 'Al-Ni'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY design_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.3
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.unit = 'GPa'
  AND cp.value >= 150
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC, cp.value ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT CASE
         WHEN c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn') THEN '3d_transition_metal_A_site'
         WHEN c.element IN ('Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
                            'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg') THEN '4d_5d_transition_metal_A_site'
       END AS a_site_transition_metal_group,
       COUNT(*) AS count,
       AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS stable_percentage,
       AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_eform
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn',
                    'Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
                    'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg')
GROUP BY CASE
           WHEN c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn') THEN '3d_transition_metal_A_site'
           WHEN c.element IN ('Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
                              'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg') THEN '4d_5d_transition_metal_A_site'
         END
ORDER BY a_site_transition_metal_group
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    s.lattice_a,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
    AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < (
        SELECT ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom
        FROM material_entry m_ref
        JOIN structure s_ref ON s_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
        JOIN phase_stability ps_ref ON ps_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
        WHERE
            m_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al'
            AND (s_ref.prototype = 'L12' OR s_ref.strukturbericht = 'L12')
        ORDER BY ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
        LIMIT 1
    )
    AND cp.value > (
        SELECT cp_ref.value
        FROM material_entry m_ref
        JOIN structure s_ref ON s_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
        JOIN calculation calc_ref ON calc_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
        JOIN calculated_property cp_ref ON cp_ref.calculation_id = calc_ref.calculation_id
        WHERE
            m_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al'
            AND (s_ref.prototype = 'L12' OR s_ref.strukturbericht = 'L12')
            AND cp_ref.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
        ORDER BY cp_ref.value DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS rebased_formation_energy_per_atom,
       s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  (
    (1.0 - LEAST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.05) / 0.05) * 0.30
    + (1.0 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.30
    + 0.0 * 0.20
    + (-ps.formation_energy_per_atom / 1.0) * 0.20
  ) AS composite_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY composite_score DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT c.element AS a_site,
       AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_rebased_formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY avg_rebased_formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS rebased_formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND c.element = 'Ni'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.1
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND c.element = 'Ni'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       c_a.element AS a_element,
       c_a.atomic_fraction AS a_atomic_fraction,
       c_b.element AS b_element,

  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) AS stable_l12_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = FALSE) AS not_stable_l12_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Al'
  )
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull > 0.001
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS b_site,
       COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS stable_l12_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY stable_l12_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.prototype,
  s.strukturbericht,
  s.formula_type,
  s.space_group_number,
  s.space_group,
  s.lattice_a,
  s.lattice_b,
  s.lattice_c,
  s.volume_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND calc.functional = 'GGA-PBE'
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable,
       cp.property_name,
       cp.value,
       cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE c.element = 'Fe'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name IN ('C11', 'C12', 'C44')
ORDER BY m.formula, cp.property_name
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.value >= 160
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula,
       c_a.element AS a_site,
       c_a.atomic_fraction AS a_site_atomic_fraction,
       c_b.element AS b_site,
       c_b.atomic_fraction AS b_site_atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c_a.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND c_b.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
ORDER BY m.formula, c_a.element, c_b.element
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND ps.energy_above_hull = 0
    AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.4
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)(Sc|Ti|V|Cr|Mn|Fe|Co|Ni|Cu|Zn|Y|Zr|Nb|Mo|Tc|Ru|Rh|Pd|Ag|Cd|Hf|Ta|W|Re|Os|Ir|Pt|Au|Hg|Rf|Db|Sg|Bh|Hs|Mt|Ds|Rg|Cn)(-|$)'
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, m.formula ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
  AND (
      EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM composition c_ni WHERE c_ni.entry_id = m.entry_id AND c_ni.element = 'Ni')
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM composition c_co WHERE c_co.entry_id = m.entry_id AND c_co.element = 'Co')
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC,
         ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       s.lattice_a,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
       ((1 - ps.energy_above_hull / 0.05) * 0.4
        + (1 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 0.3) * 0.3
        + (cp.value / 300) * 0.3) AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.unit = 'GPa'
ORDER BY weighted_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM composition c
      WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
        AND c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  )
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT c_a.element AS a_site,
       c_b.element AS b_site,
       COUNT(*) AS total,
       AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS stable_percentage
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
GROUP BY c_a.element, c_b.element
ORDER BY stable_percentage DESC, avg_energy_above_hull ASC, total DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  ((1.0 - ps.energy_above_hull / 0.05) * 0.35
   + (1.0 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 0.3) * 0.35
   + (cp.value / 300.0) * 0.30) AS score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  cp_eh.value AS energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp_b.value AS bulk_modulus,
  ((1 - cp_eh.value / 0.05) * 0.35
   + (1 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.35
   + (LEAST(cp_b.value, 300) / 300) * 0.30) AS score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc_eh ON calc_eh.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_eh ON cp_eh.calculation_id = calc_eh.calculation_id
JOIN calculation calc_b ON calc_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_b ON cp_b.calculation_id = calc_b.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp_eh.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
  AND cp_eh.value <= 0.05
  AND cp_b.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.formula,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Co'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY lattice_diff ASC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, NULL::numeric AS corrected_enthalpy
FROM material_entry m
WHERE m.formula = 'Co3Ti'
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    CASE
        WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 'stable'
        WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 'metastable'
        ELSE 'unstable'
    END AS stability
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.is_stable,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
       s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
       ((1 - LEAST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.05) / 0.05) * 0.30
        + (1 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.25
        + CASE
            WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3 THEN 0.20
            ELSE 0.10
          END) AS design_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.chemical_system != 'Al-Ni'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY design_score DESC,
         ps.energy_above_hull ASC,
         lattice_diff ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.3
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.unit = 'GPa'
  AND cp.value >= 150
ORDER BY cp.value DESC, s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT CASE
         WHEN c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn') THEN '3d_transition_metal_A_site'
         WHEN c.element IN ('Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
                            'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg') THEN '4d_5d_transition_metal_A_site'
       END AS a_site_transition_series,
       COUNT(*) AS count,
       AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS stable_percentage,
       AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_eform
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn',
                    'Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
                    'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND NOT (m.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3') OR m.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3'))
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < (
      SELECT ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN structure s_ref ON s_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN phase_stability ps_ref ON ps_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      WHERE (m_ref.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3') OR m_ref.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3'))
        AND (s_ref.prototype = 'L12' OR s_ref.strukturbericht = 'L12')
      LIMIT 1
  )
  AND cp.value > (
      SELECT cp_ref.value
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN structure s_ref ON s_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN calculation calc_ref ON calc_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN calculated_property cp_ref ON cp_ref.calculation_id = calc_ref.calculation_id
      WHERE (m_ref.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3') OR m_ref.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3'))
        AND (s_ref.prototype = 'L12' OR s_ref.strukturbericht = 'L12')
        AND cp_ref.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
      LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  (
    (1 - LEAST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.05) / 0.05) * 0.30
    + (1 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.30
    + 0.0 * 0.20
    + (-ps.formation_energy_per_atom / 1.0) * 0.20
  ) AS composite_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY composite_score DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT c.element AS a_site,
       COUNT(*) AS stable_l12_count,
       AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_rebased_formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY avg_rebased_formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS rebased_formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Ni'
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.1
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Ni'
  AND m.number_of_elements >= 2
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  ca.element AS a_element,
  ca.atomic_fraction AS a_atomic_fraction,
  cb.element AS b_element,
  cb.atomic_fraction AS b_atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition ca ON ca.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition cb ON cb.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE m.number_of_elements = 2
  AND ca.atomic_fraction = 0.75
  AND cb.atomic_fraction = 0.25
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Co'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.crystal_system
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.crystal_system = 'cubic'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY m.formula ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Al'
ORDER BY m.formula

SELECT m.formula, s.space_group_number
