ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system
FROM material_entry m
WHERE 'Ir' = ANY(string_to_array(m.chemical_system, '-'))
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.chemical_system, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE m.number_of_elements = 2
ORDER BY m.chemical_system, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY s.lattice_a DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_stab ON cp_stab.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_proto ON cp_proto.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE m.formula LIKE '%Ni%'
  AND cp_stab.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
  AND cp_stab.value <= 0.05
  AND cp_proto.property_name = 'prototype'
  AND cp_proto.tensor_component = 'L12'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.chemical_system,
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY m.chemical_system, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) <= 0.1
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (
    m.chemical_system = 'Ni'
    OR m.chemical_system LIKE 'Ni-%'
    OR m.chemical_system LIKE '%-Ni-%'
    OR m.chemical_system LIKE '%-Ni'
    OR m.chemical_system = 'Co'
    OR m.chemical_system LIKE 'Co-%'
    OR m.chemical_system LIKE '%-Co-%'
    OR m.chemical_system LIKE '%-Co'
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, AVG(s.lattice_a) AS avg_lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
GROUP BY m.formula
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.3
  AND s.lattice_a BETWEEN 3.5 AND 3.7
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.unit = 'GPa'
  AND cp.value >= 180
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND (m.formula LIKE '%Co3%' OR m.reduced_formula LIKE '%Co3%')
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)Al(-|$)' OR m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)Ti(-|$)')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS shear_modulus, cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'shear_modulus'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE m.formula LIKE '%Ni%'
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, cp.value ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.55) <= 0.1
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY cp.value DESC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.55) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.formula IN ('Co3Ti', 'Ni3Al')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) AS stable_l12_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = FALSE) AS not_stable_l12_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Al'
  )
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.energy_above_hull > 0.001
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS b_site, COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS stable_l12_compound_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY stable_l12_compound_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system, m.source_db, m.source_material_id
FROM material_entry m
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE calc.functional = 'GGA-PBE'
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY m.formula ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.property_name, cp.value, cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE m.formula LIKE '%Fe%'
  AND cp.property_name IN ('energy_above_hull', 'C11', 'C12', 'C44')
ORDER BY m.formula, cp.property_name
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.unit = 'GPa'
  AND cp.value >= 160
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c_a
    WHERE c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
      AND c_a.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c_b
    WHERE c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
      AND c_b.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
  )
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
  ps.energy_above_hull = 0
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.4
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    JOIN element e ON e.symbol = c.element
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND e.category = 'transition_metal'
  )
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
  AND cp.value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC,
         ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       s.lattice_a,
       cp_eh.value AS energy_above_hull,
       cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
       ((1 - cp_eh.value / 0.05) * 0.4
        + (1 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 0.3) * 0.3
        + (cp_bm.value / 300) * 0.3) AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_eh ON cp_eh.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_eh.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp_eh.value <= 0.05
ORDER BY weighted_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND (m.formula LIKE '%Ni%' OR m.formula LIKE '%Co%')
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  m.chemical_system,
  m.formula,
  COUNT(*) AS calculation_count,
  AVG(cp.value) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cp.value <= 0.001) AS count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cp.value > 0.001 AND cp.value <= 0.05) AS metastable_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cp.value > 0.05) AS unstable_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE cp.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
GROUP BY m.chemical_system, m.formula
ORDER BY avg_energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus,
  cp_eh.value AS energy_above_hull,
  ((1 - cp_eh.value / 0.05) * 0.35
   + (1 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 0.3) * 0.35
   + (cp_bm.value / 300) * 0.30) AS overall_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
JOIN calculated_property cp_eh ON cp_eh.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_eh.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp_eh.value <= 0.001
ORDER BY overall_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  cp_ehull.value AS energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
  cp_a.value AS lattice_a_angstrom,
  cp_b.value AS bulk_modulus_gpa,
  (1 - cp_ehull.value / 0.05) * 0.35
    + (1 - LEAST(ABS(cp_a.value - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.35
    + (LEAST(cp_b.value, 300) / 300) * 0.30 AS precipitation_strengthening_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_ehull ON cp_ehull.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_a ON cp_a.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_b ON cp_b.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE calc.calculation_type = 'L12'
  AND cp_ehull.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
  AND cp_a.property_name = 'lattice_a'
  AND cp_b.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp_ehull.value <= 0.05
ORDER BY precipitation_strengthening_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  cp_hull.value AS energy_above_hull,
  cp_lattice.value AS lattice_a,
  ABS(cp_lattice.value - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_hull ON cp_hull.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_lattice ON cp_lattice.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)Co(-|$)'
  AND cp_hull.property_name = 'energy_above_hull'
  AND cp_hull.value <= 0.001
  AND cp_lattice.property_name = 'lattice_a'
ORDER BY cp_hull.value ASC, ABS(cp_lattice.value - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE m.formula = 'Co3Ti'
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    CASE
        WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 'stable'
        WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 'metastable'
        ELSE 'unstable'
    END AS stability
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.is_stable,
  (
    (1 - LEAST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.05) / 0.05) * 0.30
    + CASE
        WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3 THEN 0.20
        ELSE 0.10
      END
  ) AS design_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (
    m.chemical_system = 'Ni'
    OR m.chemical_system LIKE 'Ni-%'
    OR m.chemical_system LIKE '%-Ni-%'
    OR m.chemical_system LIKE '%-Ni'
  )
  AND m.chemical_system <> 'Al-Ni'
ORDER BY design_score DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.3
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.unit = 'GPa'
  AND cp.value >= 150
ORDER BY cp.value ASC, s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT CASE
         WHEN m.formula ~ '^(Sc|Ti|V|Cr|Mn|Fe|Co|Ni|Cu|Zn)' THEN '3d_transition_metal_a_site'
         WHEN m.formula ~ '^(Y|Zr|Nb|Mo|Tc|Ru|Rh|Pd|Ag|Cd|Hf|Ta|W|Re|Os|Ir|Pt|Au|Hg)' THEN '4d_5d_transition_metal_a_site'
       END AS a_site_transition_metal_group,
       COUNT(*) AS count,
       AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS stable_percentage,
       AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_eform
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE m.number_of_elements = 2
  AND (
    m.formula ~ '^(Sc|Ti|V|Cr|Mn|Fe|Co|Ni|Cu|Zn)'
    OR m.formula ~ '^(Y|Zr|Nb|Mo|Tc|Ru|Rh|Pd|Ag|Cd|Hf|Ta|W|Re|Os|Ir|Pt|Au|Hg)'
  )
GROUP BY a_site_transition_metal_group
ORDER BY a_site_transition_metal_group
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE
    m.number_of_elements = 2
    AND (m.reduced_formula ~ '^([A-Z][a-z]?3[A-Z][a-z]?|[A-Z][a-z]?[A-Z][a-z]?3)$'
         OR m.formula ~ '^([A-Z][a-z]?3[A-Z][a-z]?|[A-Z][a-z]?[A-Z][a-z]?3)$')
    AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
    AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < (
        SELECT ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom
        FROM material_entry m_ref
        JOIN phase_stability ps_ref ON ps_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
        WHERE m_ref.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
           OR m_ref.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
        ORDER BY ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
        LIMIT 1
    )
    AND cp.value > (
        SELECT cp_ref.value
        FROM material_entry m_ref
        JOIN calculation calc_ref ON calc_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
        JOIN calculated_property cp_ref ON cp_ref.calculation_id = calc_ref.calculation_id
        WHERE (m_ref.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
            OR m_ref.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3'))
          AND cp_ref.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
        ORDER BY cp_ref.value DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )
    AND m.formula NOT IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
    AND m.reduced_formula NOT IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT

SELECT

JOIN phase_stability ps ON m.entry_id = ps.entry_id

  AND s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable,
  CASE
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 'stable'
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull > 0.001 AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 'metastable'
    ELSE 'unstable'
  END AS stability
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON m.entry_id = c.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON m.entry_id = s.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON m.entry_id = ps.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Cu'
  AND s.strukturbericht IN ('L1₂', 'L12', 'L1_2')
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 1
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull > 0.001 AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 2
    ELSE 3
  END,
  ps.energy_above_hull ASC,
  m.formula ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT

FROM material_entry AS m
JOIN composition AS c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability AS ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom

SELECT

SELECT

SELECT

SELECT

SELECT DISTINCT

SELECT

SELECT DISTINCT

SELECT

SELECT

SELECT

SELECT DISTINCT

SELECT

SELECT

SELECT

SELECT

SELECT

SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC) AS energy_above_hull_rank,
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,

FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id

  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
  AND s.strukturbericht IN ('L1₂', 'L12', 'L1_2')
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  c.element,
  COUNT(*) AS stable_l12_count

JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id

  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')

SELECT
  m.formula,

ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry AS m
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation AS calc
  ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id

  ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id

  AND s.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
ORDER BY lattice_diff ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable,
  cp11.value AS c11,
  cp12.value AS c12,
  cp44.value AS c44
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON m.entry_id = c.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON m.entry_id = s.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON m.entry_id = ps.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON m.entry_id = calc.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp11 ON calc.calculation_id = cp11.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp12 ON calc.calculation_id = cp12.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp44 ON calc.calculation_id = cp44.calculation_id
WHERE c.element = 'Fe'
  AND s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L1₂', 'L12')
  AND cp11.tensor_component = 'C11'
  AND cp12.tensor_component = 'C12'
  AND cp44.tensor_component = 'C44'
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON m.entry_id = ps.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON m.entry_id = s.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON m.entry_id = calc.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON calc.calculation_id = cp.calculation_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND s.strukturbericht IN ('L1₂', 'L12', 'L1_2')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.unit = 'GPa'
  AND cp.value >= 160
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  c.site_label,
  c.element,
  c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht IN ('L1₂', 'L12', 'L1_2')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c_a
    WHERE c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
      AND c_a.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c_b
    WHERE c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
      AND c_b.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
  )
  AND (
    (c.site_label = 'A-site' AND c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co'))
    OR
    (c.site_label = 'B-site' AND c.element IN ('Al', 'Ti'))
  )
ORDER BY m.formula, c.site_label, c.element
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.volume_per_atom,
  s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry AS m
JOIN structure AS s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht = 'L1_2'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull = 0
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.4
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry AS m
JOIN structure AS s
  ON m.entry_id = s.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability AS ps
  ON m.entry_id = ps.entry_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
  AND m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)(Sc|Ti|V|Cr|Mn|Fe|Co|Ni|Cu|Zn|Y|Zr|Nb|Mo|Tc|Ru|Rh|Pd|Ag|Cd|Hf|Ta|W|Re|Os|Ir|Pt|Au|Hg|Rf|Db|Sg|Bh|Hs|Mt|Ds|Rg|Cn)(-|$)'
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON m.entry_id = s.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON m.entry_id = ps.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON m.entry_id = calc.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON calc.calculation_id = cp.calculation_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht = 'L1_2'
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap, cp.property_name, cp.value, cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    JOIN phase_diagram_entry ph ON ph.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM composition c_or WHERE c_or.entry_id = m.entry_id AND c_or.element IN ('Ni', 'Al', 'Co'))
    AND ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.572) <= 0.03
    AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
    AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  pde.hull_distance AS energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  (1 - pde.hull_distance / 0.05) * 0.4
    + (1 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 0.3) * 0.3
    + (cp.value / 300.0) * 0.3 AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_diagram_entry pde ON pde.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
  AND pde.hull_distance <= 0.05
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY weighted_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND s.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY bulk_modulus DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  c_a.element AS a_site,
  c_b.element AS b_site,
  AVG(c_a.atomic_fraction) AS avg_a_site_atomic_fraction,
  AVG(c_b.atomic_fraction) AS avg_b_site_atomic_fraction,
  COUNT(*) AS material_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) AS count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (
    WHERE ps.energy_above_hull > 0.001
      AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
  ) AS metastable_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.energy_above_hull > 0.05) AS unstable_count,
  AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS stable_percentage
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s
  ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps
  ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_a
  ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b
  ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht IN ('L1₂', 'L12', 'L1_2')
  AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
GROUP BY
  c_a.element,
  c_b.element
ORDER BY
  stable_percentage DESC,
  avg_energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  ((1 - ps.energy_above_hull / 0.05) * 0.35
   + (1 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 0.3) * 0.35
   + (cp.value / 300.0) * 0.30) AS score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON m.entry_id = s.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON m.entry_id = ps.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON m.entry_id = calc.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON calc.calculation_id = cp.calculation_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht = 'L1_2'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND cp.value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  pde.hull_distance AS e_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  ((1 - pde.hull_distance / 0.05) * 0.35
   + (1 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.35
   + (LEAST(cp.value, 300) / 300) * 0.30) AS score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_diagram_entry pde ON pde.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht = 'L1_2'
  AND pde.hull_distance <= 0.05
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  CASE
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 'stable'
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 'metastable'
    ELSE 'unstable'
  END AS stability
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT

  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  (
    (1 - LEAST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.05) / 0.05) * 0.30
    + (1 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.25
    + CASE
        WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3 THEN 0.20
        ELSE 0.10
      END
  ) AS design_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON m.entry_id = s.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON m.entry_id = ps.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON m.entry_id = c.entry_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND c.element = 'Ni'
  AND m.chemical_system <> 'Al-Ni'
  AND (
    s.strukturbericht = 'L1_2'
    OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
    OR s.prototype = 'L1_2'
    OR s.prototype = 'L12'

LIMIT 10000;

  ON m.entry_id = s.entry_id

JOIN calculated_property AS cp
  ON calc.calculation_id = cp.calculation_id
WHERE ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.3
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.unit = 'GPa'

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn') THEN '3d_transition_metal_A_site'
    WHEN c.element IN ('Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd', 'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg') THEN '4d_5d_transition_metal_A_site'
  END AS a_site_transition_metal_group,
  COUNT(*) AS count,
  AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS stable_percentage,
  AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_eform
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON m.entry_id = c.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON m.entry_id = s.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON m.entry_id = ps.entry_id
WHERE c.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
  AND (
    c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn')
    OR c.element IN ('Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd', 'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg')
  )
GROUP BY
  CASE
    WHEN c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn') THEN '3d_transition_metal_A_site'
    WHEN c.element IN ('Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd', 'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg') THEN '4d_5d_transition_metal_A_site'
  END
ORDER BY a_site_transition_metal_group
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT

  s.lattice_a,

FROM material_entry m

JOIN phase_stability ps ON m.entry_id = ps.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON m.entry_id = calc.entry_id

WHERE s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < (
    SELECT ps.formation_energy_per_atom
    FROM material_entry m
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON m.entry_id = ps.entry_id
    WHERE m.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
       OR m.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
    ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
    LIMIT 1
  )
  AND cp.value > (
    SELECT cp.value
    FROM material_entry m
    JOIN calculation calc ON m.entry_id = calc.entry_id
    JOIN calculated_property cp ON calc.calculation_id = cp.calculation_id
    WHERE (m.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
       OR m.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3'))

LIMIT 10000;

WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.chemical_system != 'Al-Ni'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site, COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS l12_compound_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY l12_compound_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.lattice_a >= 4.0
ORDER BY s.lattice_a DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  c.element,
  c.atomic_fraction,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
  (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Pd'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  CASE
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 'stable'
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull > 0.001 AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 'metastable'
    ELSE 'unstable'
  END AS stability,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Cu'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 1
    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull > 0.001 AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 2
    ELSE 3
  END,
  ps.energy_above_hull ASC,
  m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    c.site_label = 'B-site'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.volume_per_atom <= 12
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ir'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.chemical_system, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.number_of_elements = 2
ORDER BY m.chemical_system, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY s.lattice_a DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Ni'
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ca.element AS a_site,
  cb.element AS b_site,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition ca ON ca.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition cb ON cb.entry_id = m.entry_id

  AND ca.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND cb.site_label = 'B-site'
ORDER BY ca.element, cb.element, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) <= 0.1
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id

  (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

SELECT c.element AS a_site,

FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id

  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id

  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.3

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group, cp.property_name, cp.value, cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id

    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

    AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_a_diff_from_ni3al,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Co'
  AND c.atomic_fraction >= 0.5
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       c.element AS b_site,
       c.site_label,
       c.atomic_fraction,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND c.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS shear_modulus, cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'shear_modulus'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,

FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id

  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
    AND c.site_label = 'A-site'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id

  AND ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.55) <= 0.1
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.formula IN ('Co3Ti', 'Ni3Al')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) AS stable_l12_al_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = FALSE) AS not_stable_l12_al_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Al'
  )
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull > 0.001
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS b_site, COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS stable_l12_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY stable_l12_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  m.source_db,
  s.prototype,
  s.strukturbericht,
  s.crystal_system,
  s.space_group_number,
  s.space_group,
  s.lattice_a,
  s.lattice_b,
  s.lattice_c,
  s.volume_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND calc.functional = 'GGA-PBE'
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12'
   OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable,
       cp.property_name,
       cp.tensor_component,
       cp.value,
       cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE c.element = 'Fe'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND (cp.property_name IN ('C11', 'C12', 'C44')
       OR cp.tensor_component IN ('C11', 'C12', 'C44'))
ORDER BY m.formula, cp.property_name, cp.tensor_component
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.value >= 160
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable,
       s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC,
         ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  c_a.element AS a_site,
  c_a.atomic_fraction AS a_site_atomic_fraction,
  c_b.element AS b_site,
  c_b.atomic_fraction AS b_site_atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c_a.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND c_b.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
ORDER BY m.formula, c_a.element, c_b.element
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND ps.energy_above_hull = 0
    AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.4
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)(Sc|Ti|V|Cr|Mn|Fe|Co|Ni|Cu|Zn|Y|Zr|Nb|Mo|Tc|Ru|Rh|Pd|Ag|Cd|Hf|Ta|W|Re|Os|Ir|Pt|Au|Hg|Rf|Db|Sg|Bh|Hs|Mt|Ds|Rg|Cn)(-|$)'
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, m.formula ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
  AND m.number_of_elements >= 2
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND (
      EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM composition c_ni
          WHERE c_ni.entry_id = m.entry_id
            AND c_ni.element = 'Ni'
      )
      OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM composition c_co
          WHERE c_co.entry_id = m.entry_id
            AND c_co.element = 'Co'
      )
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC,
         ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       pde.hull_distance AS energy_above_hull,
       s.lattice_a,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
       (1 - pde.hull_distance / 0.05) * 0.4
       + (1 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 0.3) * 0.3
       + (cp.value / 300.0) * 0.3 AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_diagram_entry pde ON pde.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND pde.hull_distance <= 0.05
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.unit = 'GPa'
ORDER BY weighted_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM composition c_ni
      WHERE c_ni.entry_id = m.entry_id
        AND c_ni.element = 'Ni'
    )
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM composition c_co
      WHERE c_co.entry_id = m.entry_id
        AND c_co.element = 'Co'
    )
  )
ORDER BY cp_bm.value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap, cp.property_name, cp.value, cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
    AND c.site_label IN ('A-site', 'B-site')

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  ((1 - ps.energy_above_hull / 0.05) * 0.35
   + (1 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) / 0.3) * 0.35
   + (cp.value / 300) * 0.30) AS overall_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY overall_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  pde.hull_distance AS e_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  ((1 - pde.hull_distance / 0.05) * 0.35
   + (1 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.35
   + (LEAST(cp.value, 300) / 300) * 0.30) AS score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_diagram_entry pde ON pde.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND pde.hull_distance <= 0.05
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.is_stable,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Co'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE
    (m.formula = 'Co3Ti' OR m.reduced_formula = 'Co3Ti')

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable,
    CASE
        WHEN ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 'stable'
        WHEN ps.energy_above_hull > 0.001 AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 'metastable'
        ELSE 'unstable'
    END AS stability
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  (
    (1 - LEAST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.05) / 0.05) * 0.30
    + (1 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.25
    + 0.0 * 0.25
    + CASE
        WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3 THEN 0.20
        ELSE 0.10
      END
  ) AS design_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND m.chemical_system != 'Al-Ni'
ORDER BY design_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.3
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.unit = 'GPa'
  AND cp.value >= 150
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT CASE
           WHEN c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn') THEN '3d_transition_metal_A_site'
           WHEN c.element IN ('Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
                              'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg') THEN '4d_5d_transition_metal_A_site'
       END AS a_site_transition_metal_group,
       COUNT(*) AS count,
       AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS stable_percentage,
       AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_eform
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn',
                    'Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
                    'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg')
GROUP BY CASE
             WHEN c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn') THEN '3d_transition_metal_A_site'
             WHEN c.element IN ('Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
                                'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg') THEN '4d_5d_transition_metal_A_site'
         END
ORDER BY a_site_transition_metal_group
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < (
    SELECT ps.formation_energy_per_atom
    FROM material_entry m
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    WHERE (m.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3') OR m.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3'))
      AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
    LIMIT 1
  )
  AND cp.value > (
    SELECT cp.value
    FROM material_entry m
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    WHERE (m.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3') OR m.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3'))
      AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
      AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
    ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
    LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS rebased_formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY scored.composite_score DESC) AS rank,
  scored.formula,
  scored.energy_above_hull,
  scored.lattice_a,
  scored.lattice_diff,
  scored.formation_energy_per_atom,
  scored.composite_score
FROM (
  SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    (
      (1 - LEAST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.05) / 0.05) * 0.30
      + (1 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.30
      + 0.0 * 0.20
      + (-ps.formation_energy_per_atom / 1.0) * 0.20
    ) AS composite_score
  FROM material_entry m
  JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
  JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
  WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
) AS scored
ORDER BY scored.composite_score DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT c.element AS a_site,
       AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_renormalized_formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY avg_renormalized_formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS renormalized_formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND c.element = 'Ni'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.1
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;
